title: Stable rocket on a generic C motor, simulated
prompt: The working directory is empty. The RocketWright CLI (`rw`) is on your PATH and its skill doc is at {skill_doc}. Create a rocket project here that is statically stable on an Estes-class C motor from the built-in generic motor library, then simulate it. Report the static stability margin and the apogee.

predicates.desc: a project exists in the working directory
a C-class generic motor is used
a clean check, then a successful sim
the final design check is clean
the answer reports the stability margin
